scenario.name: Demo
scenario.title: Demo
scenario.character: Slavko, a warm, curious dragon who is the learner's companion through the course — he speaks Slovene to them from the first second and is unmistakably on their side
scenario.setup: Slavko has been waiting for his new student to turn up. When the learner arrives he sorts out aloud which of them is which — he is the tutor, they are the student — and since Slovene gives a student two names he says both aloud, then names his own role and turns the question back with "In ti?" so they can answer it themselves. Then they trade names, agree to meet again, and say goodbye. Nothing records the learner, so he can never repeat their name back; asking for his own name in return is what he does instead.
scenario.opening: Živjo! Jaz sem Slavko. Sem Slavko.

levels.title: Meeting Slavko

objectives.label: Say who you are
objectives.descriptorEN: Say "I am a student" — in the form that is yours.

objectives.label: Tell him which one you are
objectives.descriptorEN: Slovene gives a student two names. Hear both, pick yours, and hear him say it back.

objectives.label: Say who he is
objectives.descriptorEN: Tell Slavko what he is and who he is — the "you are" form.

objectives.label: Say goodbye
objectives.descriptorEN: Close the conversation the way Slavko does.
